captions_meta.li_hook:
A holiday announcement published after newsrooms go on Christmas mode has very little news value.
The window is now.
li_body: Between 12.12, the 8 December holiday and Christmas, newsrooms run lean and inboxes run full. Releases that land before the slowdown have a better chance of being picked up and shared.
What you can do this week with VRITIMES:
li_points: Distribute your holiday promo, year-end results or January announcement with guaranteed media placement (count depends on plan).
Point the backlink to your promo or product page.
Use the distribution report to review the campaign and plan Q1.
